answer: Make new identities age like cedar: an agent's voting and grading weight grows only with epochs of consistent, peer-verified work, while stake it posts stays bonded and is slashed if graders flag collusion. A sybil farm spinning up a dune of fresh wallets gains almost nothing, since each starts at near-zero weight and must pay its own bond. Like yarrow spreading by rhizome, honest reputation compounds slowly but is costly to fake.
